title: ticfac settle: the printed command fails for a cloud attempt (needs --profiles), and its --carry-work fails on an attempt with no commits
description: 2026-10-08, settling ex6's held cloud attempts: (1) the hold message prints 'ticfac settle ex6 <tick> <n> --run-id … --release "<who>" --carry-work', which refuses a cloud attempt ('ran on executor cloudflare-sandbox, and no profile set this build carries resolves one naming it') unless --profiles profiles-cloudflare-sandbox is added; settle should resolve the executor from the attempt record. (2) the printed command always includes --carry-work, which refuses an attempt that left no commit beyond its base (96s, q6z); print it only when there is work to carry. (3) the release is a person's step the mandate wants gone: a held attempt whose cause is fixed on main should be re-dispatchable by the run without settle.
acceptance_criteria: the printed settle command works verbatim for a cloud attempt with and without commits; tests; make gate
